title: AI Peer — Draft 02 illustrative concept film
voice_disclosure: Four standard synthetic voices; no voice cloning or imitation of real people.
music: Original oscillator and noise synthesis, composed separately for each story act; no third-party recording or samples.
score_structure: Sparse unanswered opening; reveal groove; Slack call-and-response; near-silent Zoom dialogue and approval moment; warm morning felt piano and tonic resolution.
notes: Every scripted word preserved. Pitch-preserving atempo is capped at 1.10. No voiced audio is trimmed to fit. SRT timing is based on TTS boundaries, not forced alignment.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A quick question. The right person. The wrong time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the context lives with one person, everyone else waits.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What if the context could stay?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet AI Peer. A teammate built around your work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before Manish signs off, his Peer connects the project requirements, his latest handoff, and the release plan.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the requirements change, the new source replaces the old one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Manish chooses what it can share, and which decisions must come back to him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now it's two a.m. in Bengaluru. But Sarah's afternoon is just getting started.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Quick question, Manish. Do you need daily totals, or the result for each dispute?

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: It's two a.m. for him. We may have to wait.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: I'm Manish's AI Peer. He's offline. I can share the project context.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: We need the final won-or-lost result for each dispute, updated hourly. It feeds the reconciliation dashboard. Here's the latest requirement.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Use Dispute Events. It refreshes hourly. The daily summary is too late. I'll send the field mapping.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Thanks, Sarah. I'll include that in Manish's handoff.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A useful answer. Without waiting for another working day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten minutes later, the same project moves into a Zoom meeting. Manish has asked his Peer to cover the update.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Hey Manish, where are we on Chargebacks? Are we ready for Friday?

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: I don't think Manish is here. It's past two in the morning for him.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Hi, I'm Manish's AI Peer. He couldn't join, so he asked me to cover this update.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Great. What's still blocking us?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: The dashboard build is complete. Two data checks are still open: the same event arriving twice, and an outcome changing later.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Sarah just confirmed the hourly data source in Slack. So that question is answered.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: I can provide those two test examples today.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Can we confirm Friday, then?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: That needs Manish's approval. I'll take back the test plan and ask him to confirm the date once validation is complete.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Perfect. We can keep validation moving.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Morning. Manish returns to the answer from Slack, the test plan from Zoom, and the sources behind both.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One decision still needs him: the launch date. Less catching up. A clear next step.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your work has a timezone. Your Peer doesn't. AI Peer. Keep the context moving.

edit.reason: Shorten silent gaps between Zoom dialogue turns while keeping the absence pause, evidence holds and every spoken word.

edit_note: Seven speech-free cuts; 12ms fade-out and fade-in at each join without changing duration. Source masters preserved.
